equipmentSemantics.authorization: Project rule specifies all existing user-defined attributes be equipment attributes; formula outcomes may change while input values remain unchanged
equipmentSemantics.mpMax: The legacy input name mpMax now means flat equipment MP capacity, corresponding to the flat-addition role of m_iAddMPValue. It is not a source field-name mapping and is not a final-capacity override.
equipmentSemantics.knownCharacterMPBaseEvidence: ResetMaxMP: ONE_CHARGE*3, with ONE_CHARGE100 in the separately hashed X2GageUI.h
equipmentSemantics.targetDefaultPassives: RF24400-24405 and LK21400-21404 raw target declarations contain no SA_MAX_MP capacity addition. LK21400 concerns MP gain; LK21403 raises HP, not MP.
equipmentSemantics.otherCharacterBases: HP/physicalAttack/magicAttack/physicalDefence/magicDefence remain uncalibrated; no old-version values are synthesized.
equipmentSemantics.pvpNormalization: No universal equipmentHP/equipmentMP multiplication by0.1 is supported by the inspected consumers. Final HP/attack/defence can come from server m_GameStat; its complete construction and item normalization are not acquired. The user-supplied combat-unit equipment contributions are retained.

flatMPRecoveryPerSecond.productionConfiguration: undefined in both RF and LK presets; absence is not asserted to be a measured zero stat

flatMPRecoveryPerSecond.executorSupport: unsupported: a nonzero optional equipment mpRecoveryPerSecond records equipment-mp-clock-unsupported and has no guessed effect; complete independent equipment recovery clock is not integrated
flatMPRecoveryPerSecond.scope: No new value is added to the presets in this task

frameSemantics.gate: one actor.lastCombatResourceStep shared by attack, received, effect callbacks; MP and awakening consume together
frameSemantics.webAdapter: simulation step replaces source CommonFrameMove reset; complete native Now/Future order is not reproduced
frameSemantics.zeroGain: eligible callback still consumes gate when MP is capped, HIT_ADD_MP is0 or soul already has3orbs
frameSemantics.localOwnership: retain actor-local gate for networkOwner; disposable remote clones may mutate their own copy; peer snapshots must never import this gate into the owned actor
frameSemantics.sourceExclusions: attacker character: RT_NO_DAMAGE/RT_SENSOR and DT_BUFF; attacker effect: RT_NO_DAMAGE and DT_BUFF; received: IsDamagedReaction && !NO_DAMAGE, which includes RT_DUMMY_DAMAGE
frameSemantics.receivedBuffBoundary: received source block has no standalone DT_BUFF test; ordinary periodic buff consumers bypass combat hit routing. Do not infer new periodic-buff resource rewards from the helper.
frameSemantics.soulExclusions: attack: positive HP_PERCENT_UP, MP_PERCENT_UP or INCREASE_MP; received: positive HP_PERCENT_UP; both capped at3orbs
